data.description: RED task. Wrap the tickets-branch commit+push site in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py with rebase_retry(repo_root, write_fn, max_attempts=3) from _concurrency.py. On non-fast-forward push rejection: git fetch + git rebase + retry. On success within 3 attempts, pass continues. On exhaustion, propagate Result to caller (task-4 handles the reject-and-reschedule exit). Unit tests: succeeds within 3 attempts under simulated rejections, first-try success with no contention, rebase invoked between attempts.
data.title: Wrap tickets-branch write path in rebase_retry loop (up to 3 attempts)
